title: tampines: critical_flow doc claims Marviken validation that does not exist

description:
MAINTAINER REQUEST 2026-08-11: once the HTR-10 multifidelity neutronics pipeline lands, wire it into the outram-blender port.

THE PIPELINE: rigorous Monte Carlo -> MGXS -> deterministic multiphysics -> PRKE + decay heat. Each rung trades fidelity for speed and is validated against the rung above it. Scoped under op-jyyp (HTR-10 simulator); the scoping document is docs/reactor-scoping/htr10-neutronics.md.

WHY BLENDER IS THE RIGHT HOME. crates/outram-blender is the mesh-authoring frontend and ALREADY carries exactly this pattern twice over:
- an opt-in Monte Carlo bridge: mc-export -> sim -> MC Studio
- an OpenFOAM volume-meshing bridge: foam-mesh -> foam_mesh -> tet-dual Mesh Studio
The multifidelity pipeline becomes a THIRD bridge of the same shape — author the geometry, then drive the fidelity ladder from it. The existing MC bridge is the closest precedent and should be read first; rung 1 of the pipeline is the same Monte Carlo engine that bridge already targets, so this may extend that bridge rather than sit beside it. Decide which and record why.

DESIGN CONSTRAINT ALREADY COMMUNICATED UPSTREAM. The pipeline agent has been told to give the pipeline a HEADLESS, SCRIPTABLE entry point taking a geometry description plus a run configuration, rather than something only callable from a test — precisely so a frontend can drive it. If that constraint was not honoured, fixing the pipeline API is in scope here before wrapping it.

REPRODUCIBILITY CARRIES THROUGH THE BRIDGE. The pipeline must emit a run manifest recording the workspace commit, cross-section data and version, MC seed and batch counts, group structure and homogenisation choice. A frontend that drives the pipeline must PRESERVE and surface that manifest rather than hiding it behind a button — a result a user cannot trace back to its inputs is not usable as evidence. Same discipline as the graph digitiser bead op-5v5.8, which must record calibration with every export.

BLOCKED UNTIL THE PIPELINE LANDS. Do not start this before the rungs exist. Filed now so the intent is not lost, and so the pipeline is designed with a frontend consumer in mind rather than retrofitted.

Note outram-blender is GPL-3.0, a fork of Blender mesh architecture, and is NOT affiliated with the Blender Foundation — keep that framing intact in any docs added here.
title: outram-blender: multifidelity neutronics pipeline as a third solver bridge
